R4C-bear-backcountry-0004.name: By Akamina Creek
R4C-bear-backcountry-0004.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).
R4C-bear-backcountry-0004.parkWhat: pull off on an unnamed gravel road

evidence.t: Burn from 2017 (fire N11966), right here: burned areas are spring bear food (90%) and huckleberry grows in old burns (80%) (lessons: Black bear Masterclass 5, Habitat tour).
SW facing slope, 10 degrees: grassy south facing slopes are spring bear food (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
Akamina Creek 70 m S: stream sides and skunk cabbage swamps are spring food, and bears forage on berries and spawning fish in fall (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).

flags.t: MU (Management Unit) 4-1, Region 4 Kootenay.
Spot is inside a Motor Vehicle Closed Area: Flathead River Eastside, Akamina Creek and Kishinena Peak. Closed Year Round. Synopsis map 1-61/23.
Route crosses provincial park: Akamina-Kishinena Park. Hunting only where that park allows it, in open season. Check its bcparks.ca page (synopsis page 9, 99%).

CWD (Chronic Wasting Disease) Management Zone, MU 4-1: every deer, elk and moose taken here must have its head sampled at a CWD freezer before you leave the zone (www.gov.bc.ca/CWDdropoff). Brain and spinal column (vertebrae, not the tail) may not leave the zone: leave them at the kill site or a landfill in it (synopsis pages 15, 36, 37, 99%).

Region 4: it is unlawful to feed or bait deer, elk, moose and other hoofed game, or turkeys, anywhere in the Kootenay Region (synopsis page 37, 99%). Snowmobiles may not be used for hunting in Region 4 from 1 April to 30 November (page 37, 99%).

seasonRows.notes: bag 2; private land only, with landowner permission

plan: Drive: from District of Sparwood, about 127 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 49.03046, -114.04261, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 7.5 km W, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 219 m, about 172 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 100 m S of the spot at 1,594 m (49.05091, -114.12172). Water: Akamina Creek 20 m N (estimate).

Hunt: black bear, Apr, May, June, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass berry slopes, cutblocks and road edges at dawn and the last 2 hours of light, wind in your face (Tip). A bear under 2 years old and any bear with it are closed (99%, synopsis page 11).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 180 grain expanding bullet (Tip).

Legal: MU (Management Unit) 4-1, Region 4. CWD zone: deer, elk and moose heads go to a CWD freezer; brain and spine stay in the zone. No baiting in Region 4. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
